claims.claim: Direct Belgium tyres (implying genuine imported used European tyres)
claims.evidence: No brand, DOT code, or origin marking is visible or read from any photo; origin cannot be confirmed remotely.

claims.claim: Tyres and wheels (rims) are sold together
claims.evidence: Rims are visible in the background/edges of Photos 0-2 but it is not shown whether they are included in this sale or just sitting nearby.

risks.proof: Clear close-up of the sidewall size markings (e.g. 205/55R16)
risks.if_unproven: priced as unspecified/generic small size, lowest tier

risks.proof: Close-up photo of the DOT code on the sidewall
risks.if_unproven: priced as old stock, worst-case age

risks.risk: Tread depth not measurable from photos
risks.proof: Close-up with a tread depth gauge or coin test on each tyre
risks.if_unproven: priced as low tread / near end-of-life

risks.risk: Possible punctures, patches, or sidewall damage
risks.proof: Full 360° video of each tyre including inner sidewall and repair marks

risks.risk: Exact number of tyres and rims included unclear
risks.proof: Single photo showing the full lot laid out and counted, with seller confirming inclusion of rims
risks.if_unproven: priced for the minimum count visible (4 tyres, rims excluded)

risks.risk: Yellow chalk marks could indicate defect flags from inspection, not just sorting marks
risks.proof: Seller explanation plus close-up of marked area for cracks or bulges
risks.if_unproven: priced as flagged/defective at that spot

proof_requests: Close-up photos of each tyre's sidewall showing size, DOT code, and load/speed rating
Full rotation video of each tyre showing tread and inner sidewall for damage
Clear count and confirmation of whether rims are included in the sale price
Any proof of import/origin (invoice, customs marking, or container photo) if the 'Belgium' claim matters to valuation
response.reason: The witness confirms these are used car tyres, which can be priced at worst case given missing size, age, tread, and damage data; the seller's origin and rims-included claims remain unverified and do not raise the price until proven.
